note: Both sets share the same core claims and the same two errors (the 3" dimension misbound as subfloor thickness, and an unsupported "3/4\" MDF EDGE STRIP" quote). Set B additionally captures the substrate slope of 1/4" per foot, a real spec that Set A omits, and a base-layer fact for the bathroom floor. Set A is somewhat more faithful in binding the 1/2" gypsum and 3/8" porcelain tile to their specific details (D3/D5), whereas Set B restates those facts vaguely and repeats the backsplash scale and wall-tile thickness. On balance B's extra correct spec outweighs its duplication noise.
remarks: The 3" dimension in the D1 shower pan detail is a plan/width dimension with arrowheads, not a subfloor thickness; both extractions bind it to the subfloor. The page never states an edge-strip thickness — "3/4\" MDF" belongs to the gable, so both edge-strip claims are fabricated. Both sets also miss the (GT) tile designation and the LINE OF FIN. COUNTERTOP reference in D3.
